scenario: Offshore Tropical Storm and Coastal Weather Analysis
location_context: Oceanic Region Near a Coastal Landmass
detailed_description: Satellite imagery showing a large organized storm system over the ocean near a coastal landmass. The scene is dominated by extensive bright cloud cover with curved and spiral cloud structures indicating a rotating atmospheric system. The densest cloud mass is concentrated offshore, while nearby land and coastline are visible toward the upper and left portions of the image. The storm is primarily located over the ocean rather than directly over the coastal region.
visible_features: Large organized cloud system located predominantly over the ocean
Dense bright cloud mass associated with intense atmospheric activity
Curved and spiral cloud bands extending outward from the main storm system
Dark ocean surface visible around portions of the cloud system
Nearby coastal landmass visible along the upper and left edges of the image
Outer cloud bands extending toward the coastal region
Broad circulation pattern suggesting a tropical storm or cyclone-like system

land_use_information.open_ocean: Dominant surface visible beneath and around the storm system
land_use_information.coastal_land: Visible along the upper and left portions of the image
land_use_information.dense_cloud_cover: Dominant atmospheric feature across the central and southern portions
land_use_information.direct_land_impact: The main storm center appears offshore; only outer cloud bands approach the nearby coastal region

detected_changes_and_patterns: Large-scale rotating or curved cloud organization
Dense central cloud concentration over the ocean
Outer cloud bands extending away from the main storm mass
Storm system positioned near, but not primarily over, the coastline
Potential movement of the weather system toward or parallel to the coastal region cannot be determined from a single image
possible_environmental_impacts: Heavy rainfall in nearby coastal areas if outer rain bands move inland
Strong winds and rough sea conditions over the affected ocean region
Potential coastal flooding or storm surge depending on storm intensity and track
Disruption to marine transportation and fishing activity
Increased wave activity and coastal erosion risk

predefined_observations.recommended_actions: Monitor sequential satellite images and meteorological data to track storm movement, intensity, cloud development, and potential impacts on nearby coastal regions.
